_comment: Stored fallback results for the Weather Research agent. Used when no model is available or the model returns invalid JSON twice. Always written with source = "fallback". Hand-written for the SYNTHETIC demo zone; not model output.

trinity-bottoms.summary: Synthetic reports describe street flooding, closed low-water crossings and a river gauge forecast above flood stage in the Trinity Bottoms zone. Power and cell service are degraded, so silent phones are expected and need welfare checks.
evidence: Water over curbs on Levee St after 4 inches of rain in two hours.
Three low-water crossings closed; several cars stalled.
About 6,000 customers without power; cell towers on backup power.
River gauge forecast to crest 2 ft above flood stage tonight.
Swift-water rescue teams staged; residents urged to move to higher ground.

_default.summary: No model assessment is available for this zone. Severity is held at a conservative placeholder until an analyst or the model reviews the evidence.
